preview.boundary: Production fillDeepList and detail/highlight/group renderers only. Read-only explicit original-contract mock supplies 200 logical persons, 2000 physical person and queue slots, 38 cities, player king, complete kind-3 menu DTO and incomplete 13-property default person DTO, identity byteLength 207195. Fourteen actual-ID rows include a long full name, four-character names and equal names with distinct IDs. Fixture changes only Devotion of ordinary persons 17 and 2 (255/0 to 0/255) then sets personProperties.custom, preserving ruler id 0 with unused Devotion 37, Level/Arms, Force/IQ/Thew, complete menu/owner and never clearing deepSig. Ruler loyalty is the original -- placeholder. Only private mobileHost isAvailable capability assignment is added. Lifecycle/configure/start/bind, actual bridge/LIB/WASM/storage/save/gameplay/physical devices are excluded.
preview.processBoundary: Exactly one owned Chrome context/profile and one private ephemeral allowlist HTTP server; only owned pages/context/server closed. No existing browser/game/CDP/8080/process inventory accessed.

testScope.correction: Replace accidental U+0008 regex word boundaries with literal backslash-b; retain previous candidate and edit review
testScope.layoutFix: Existing case asserts exactly one nested noninteractive loyalty span; no new case/module

semanticReview.scope: Static source and baseline-copy comparison only. No test execution, browser, Git, game or saved-state access.
semanticReview.conclusion: The ruler null/display -- branch and ordinary allied raw U8 Devotion branch match original case-5 semantics within the existing original-library, default-13-property, own-city list eligibility. No engine change is needed.

evidence.meaning: JavaScript exposes the same native Devotion U8 field.
Original property formatting reads actual person Belong.
Case 5 emits ATRR_STR71 for a ruler, raw Devotion for other owned people, and ATRR_STR71 for unowned people.
Existing ordinary route stays deepKind person, step zero; special goods/reward/confiscation/transfer/surrender flows remain excluded.
Existing original LIB fingerprint, native counts, current own-city and default-property eligibility remains unchanged.
Default native profile is required, custom false and propertyCount 13.
Every displayed native ID must actually belong to g_PlayerKing+1. Under this condition id===king is exactly equivalent to native Belong===id+1.
Receipt current fence retains the actual king and own-city ownership.
Sample now carries the same verified king to the value and final-raw phases.
Ruler branch stores null without accessing person.Devotion; ordinary branch reads native integer U8 0..255 without clamping to 100.
Both complete value reads, including ordinary loyalty or ruler null, must match under the same source.
After external profile callbacks, final raw fence compares ordinary Devotion and short-circuits ruler Devotion access.
Existing signature includes the full rows, so ordinary loyalty changes participate in list refresh and stale press invalidation.
Existing second summary line adds raw ordinary loyalty; null renders --.

relatedExistingChecks.subject: Filtered/reordered native IDs and duplicate names preserve public items and input.
Same-owner value refresh retires held presses across actual row refresh.
Eligibility withdrawal before private field access, numeric validation, torn reads, reentry and late callback fences.
Existing native property expected-value oracle distinguishes ruler/unowned -- from other raw loyalty.

recommendedVerificationFocus: Ruler ID at a nonzero g_PlayerKing must still yield -- and never invoke a throwing Devotion getter.
Ordinary 0 and 255 are valid; invalid, torn and late changed ordinary Devotion must withdraw the whole enhancement using the existing receipt.
Loyalty-only update must refresh signature and reject a held old-row press while preserving fresh ordinary input behavior.

firstPreviewRejection.reason: PC narrow two-column list splits the newly added loyalty label between 忠 and 诚255. Preserve each loyalty label/value as one unbroken inline group before acceptance.
